problems.title: Machine Not Turning On
problems.problem: The milk analyzer does not start when the power button is pressed.
possible_causes: Power cable is not connected properly
solutions: Check if the power cable is properly connected.
Ensure the power adapter is plugged into the socket.
If the machine still does not start, contact service support.

problems.title: Machine Showing Error Code
problems.problem: The machine displays an error code on the screen.
solutions: Wait for 10 seconds before turning it back on.
If the error continues, inform the service engineer.

problems.title: Milk Sample Not Reading
problems.problem: The analyzer does not show fat or SNF values.
solutions: Stir the milk sample properly before testing.
Ensure the tube has no air bubbles.

problems.title: Machine Showing Incorrect Results
problems.problem: The milk analyzer shows abnormal fat values.
solutions: Test with a fresh milk sample.

problems.title: Machine Making Unusual Noise
problems.problem: The machine produces abnormal sound during testing.
solutions: Check if any tube is blocked.
Contact the service engineer if the noise continues.

problems.title: Machine Not Sucking Milk
problems.problem: The analyzer is not taking the milk sample.
solutions: If the issue persists, contact service support.
